lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gills; a primary column contains four distinct centroids, followed by several subsequent columns maintaining a roughly equidistant vertical spacing between points.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid where the blobs act as nodes within the lighter vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal linear feature is visible along the dorsal-lateral interface, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition between high-intensity light on the dorsal side and shadow on the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remoras) near the pectoral fin and a high-density cluster of smaller spots in the cephalic region anterior to the gills.
